author: Mike Kasberg
units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

designDecisions.adaptation: Both actual guide walls and four tongues are exactly 1.6 mm thick; deck independently thickened to 2–2.8 mm.
4.4 mm tongue + .10 mm total allowance reproduces source socket. Width4.4–6; proposed default total allowance .15; calibrated/material dependent, all four fixed joints require adhesive.
Original carrier reconstructed with twelve accessible .4–.6 mm thick, .8–1.4 mm wide runners; simulated safe snips release three parts plus carrier.

designDecisions.original: Paired walls and scored deck replace ship assembly
designDecisions.adaptation: Clear work channel24–32 mm, guide length70–86, wall height18–26, square and ±25–45 degree scoring planes. Minimum normal blade envelope .8–1.6. Diagonal rectangular slot mouth = envelope/cos(angle) + 1.6*tan(angle); no undercut. Floor6 mm above deck requires sacrificial spacer.
20x20 image surface or exact verified closed convex STL is Boolean-subtracted at (0,-length/2+12); up to .6 mm depth leaves at least1.4 mm solid backing, outside four sockets.

sourceDefects: Nonwatertight reference used for measurements only. No automatic repair, no private source publication, no raw STL redistribution. Original reconstruction uses Manifold CSG.
sharedInfrastructure: Reusable maker-studio UI, import parser and export/test helpers adapted from earlier local applications; guide solids, assembly placement, cutting-plane calculations and tests are new.
